# Camp Resource: Railway Water Tower

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Aug 13, 2024
- 2 min read

Updated: Sep 28, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_28bdbbdda1814d79b6c55335db273244~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

Keep your C.A.M.P. hydrated with this rustic Railroad Water Tower.

Generates Dirty Water.

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Railway Water Tower__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_27bbe21661af4e1db3164c2210c2a91c~mv2.png)

**Produces**

Dirty Water

**Build limit per camp**

No Limit per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

No Limit per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Water

**Holds**

4 Dirty Water

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - __Railroad Water Tower__ - 500 Atoms

Atom Shop - __Free States Defense Bundle__ - 1500 Atoms

**Produces X amount per**

Every 5 minutes and 1 second

**Lockable**

Yes

#### **Flamingo Units**

2 Flamingo Units

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_37a8ee666027440d97d4c2ae0b5393e1~mv2.png)
